what: While a strip of 16:9 photo cells flows backwards (to the right) endlessly with Swiper, one cell per 6 seconds, every frame each cell turns as if stuck to the inside face of a cylinder by the square e of its distance d (0–1) from the strip center — rotateY ∓25e°, translateZ −150(1−e)px, scale 1+.07e, 5e% clipped on left and right (phone 12°, 50px, .01, 0). The image treats the whole strip as one cylinder of curvature .75 (phone .35) in WebGL, flattening the horizontal coordinate with sin, and darkens toward the edges by .7+.3·cos — on the service hero, a strip where site photos flow along a round wall.

options.speed: Length of one cell flow (ms), default 6000
options.dir: If left, flows to the left (default is reversed — original reverseDirection)
options.per · per-sp: Cells per screen — 2.7 at 768px and up · 1.35 below that
options.curve · curve-sp: Cylinder curvature (radians) — .75 · .35. At 0 the image is flat and only the CSS rotation remains
options.scale · scale-sp: Growth ratio of the edge cells — .07 · .01
options.[data-fx-part=track]: Swiper version (.swiper-container > .swiper-wrapper > .swiper-slide) — to tilt the band, use rotate(-8.26deg) in the consuming css
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Artwork slot inside the cell (optional, otherwise the cell itself) — the inner one draws it, and if absent draws a placeholder labeled with data-label
options.fx:step: Event fired on the element each time a cell turns over — the original swaps the center device screen with a .8s cross fade every other time

use: …
note: /  One WebGL pane per band, drawn onto each cell’s 2D pane — one per cell would exceed 16 including loop clones and the browser would drop the earlier panes. Images from other origins need crossorigin to load onto the pane

from.where: index.html Hero photo strip (.hc-mv__strip — Swiper 5.4.5, strip rotate(-8.26deg) · 290px up, center device screen fade on every second fx:step)
